items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Didn't Dodge play drums with Fate Marable at once? Yeah, he played good boy with him.

ctx.x: I didn't play with him. Yeah, well where did he come from? I think he come from St. Louis, didn't he?
I don't know. I believe that's where he comes from. Didn't Dodge play drums with Fate Marable at once? Yeah, he played good boy with him. I didn't know. I didn't know.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Well, I had Kid Ora, Bischie, Johnny Dodds, now I took Lewis plays, Baby Dodds on drums.

ctx.x: Who was in the band at the 25s?
Well, I had Kid Ora, Bischie, Johnny Dodds, now I took Lewis plays, Baby Dodds on drums. Then you know piano, huh? Two clarinets, huh?

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: the first people I saw was playing at the 25, Louis Armstrong, Kid Ory, Johnny Dots, Baby Dots, and Bob Lyons on bass

ctx.x: since you're both sick right now.

Well, about me and Louis, I'll tell you about that. Uh... I left the country in 1918, and I was 18 years old. I went to World War I, and when I came back, the first people I saw was playing at the 25, Louis Armstrong, Kid Ory, Johnny Dots, Baby Dots, and Bob Lyons on bass, and Lorenzo Starrs on guitar, so... You had to play in a drum?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Lorenzo Stahl on guitar, and Bob Lyons on bass. That's how it was. And I played them two tunes

ctx.x: Well, Chris was a nice man with a plunger, you know. He was a plunger man. Yeah, I know. Well, I'm going to tell you how this happened. When I first came here from the Army, somebody carried me down to 25, where Louis was playing. And I got up there and played two numbers over there and some other song I played. And oh, that's the, let me see what, no, Kid Olive wasn't there. There's Kid Orange, Johnny Dots, Baby Dots, Lorenzo Stahl on guitar, and Bob Lyons on bass. That's how it was. And I played them two tunes…
Well was Louis copying anybody at that time? Did he have his own style already?
